narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Spiral
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multiple kinetic conflicts escalate simultaneously: US-Iran active exchanges, Israel two-front operations, and deep Ukraine strikes. The EIA's extended Hormuz blockade timeline and the Apache shootdown confirm the conflict is broadening, not de-escalating, driving a structural risk-off shift.
narratives.trade_implication: Short S&P 500 futures; long WTI crude oil and gold; long VIX futures.

narratives.title: Hormuz Blockade Structural Oil Shock
narratives.summary: The Strait of Hormuz blockade is now structurally priced through Q3 2026 per EIA, with Kuwait actively seeking pipeline bypasses. This is not a transient spike but a multi-year supply disruption, forcing capital into energy commodities and away from import-dependent equities.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil futures; long energy sector ETFs; short Asian and European equity indices.

narratives.title: Institutional DeFi and Crypto Divergence
narratives.summary: While BTC crashed on macro risk-off, institutional adoption continues with Janus Henderson's tokenized CLO partnership. Capital is rotating from speculative crypto into regulated, yield-bearing DeFi instruments, creating a bifurcation between BTC as risk proxy and institutional DeFi as a separate growth story.
narratives.trade_implication: Long ENA and tokenized asset protocols; short BTC futures; long DeFi index tokens.
